checks.description: Editing a data filtering profile as read (unset fields null, plus the service's own id, name, tenant_id, type, version, audit_metadata and is_parent_managed): Edit… opens it as a JSON draft, Review change accepts it unchanged, Apply… opens the native sheet and Return applies it: exactly one PUT /dlp/v2/api/data-filtering-profiles/<id> whose body holds the draft without the nulls or the service's own fields, and the window says it was read back.

limitations: The endpoints are local synthetic fixtures shaped after the live behaviours found in C25 (live receipts under evidence/C25/live). The fixture filtering profile uses the request contract's direction BOTH and log_severity LOW: the live service stores c2s and low, which the SDK contract refuses (an SDK follow-up recorded in blocked-gaps.md).
Focus visibility is measured on the fixture build's own WebView snapshot; spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded; AX roles, names and focus are inspected.
